basics.name: Corentin Michel
basics.label: Technical Lead · Senior Scientific Computing Engineer (Python)
basics.summary: Since 2025 I have been the technical lead within my team: follow-up of the development contract, specifications and bid analysis for 2027-2030, coordination with the other teams, technical debt. I rely on hands-on development: I write and industrialise Python neutronics code that secures and optimises nuclear reactor core reloads (ODYSSÉE calculation chain, EMC2-E operating scheme). I automate tasks at work with generative AI; on my open-source projects, I develop with coding agents whose output I review and test. Involved in associations, open source and Linux.

work.name: EDF
work.summary: Development and industrialisation of the EMC2-E operating scheme (ODYSSÉE calculation chain), a Python neutronics code that secures and optimises the reloading of nuclear reactor cores. Technical lead since 2025: wrote the specifications and analysed the bids for the 2027-2030 development contract, contract follow-up, interfaces with partner teams, technical-debt management (104 h/year recovered).

work.name: EDF
work.summary: Modelling of an international multi-physics benchmark with the ODYSSÉE chain, creation of neutron cross-section libraries for the benchmark's cycles, calculation of the cycles of a US reactor and comparison with plant data.

work.name: Assystem
work.summary: Application of the MBSE methodology to define concrete strategies in case of a Severe Accident on the EPR. Hands-on use of the CAPELLA systems engineering software.
